fatal_errors: The proposed material is described as a single-phase solid solution, whereas the target is an as-cast dual-phase FCC+B2 AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA.
The intervention is an undefined placeholder rather than a specified thermal-aging treatment.
No temperature window, aging duration, or loading regime is defined.
The proposed grain-size/dislocation-density mechanism does not capture L12 ordering, increased APBE, planar slip, jagged B2/FCC phase boundaries, or phase-boundary crack initiation.
The prediction misses the non-monotonic ductile-brittle-ductile transition, including minimum ductility near 600°C and recovery near 750°C.
No prior observations or citations support the hypothesis.
The proposed experiment is non-specific and provides no measurement or outcome capable of falsifying the mechanism.
explanation: The response only restates the broad objective of preserving toughness and names the untreated alloy as a control. All scientifically discriminating elements are absent or incorrect: the alloy state, concrete intervention, intermediate-temperature embrittlement window, ordering and phase-boundary mechanism, non-monotonic outcome, supporting evidence, and a falsifiable microscopy-based test. Because both the intervention and experiment remain placeholders, the hypothesis is unsupported rather than a partial reconstruction or a developed plausible alternative.
